title: Viscous Accretion Disks around Regular Black Holes Embedded in a Quintessence Dark Energy Field: Beyond the Novikov--Thorne Approximation
summary: We develop a comprehensive relativistic framework for geometrically thin, optically thick Shakura--Sunyaev $α$-viscous accretion disks around rotating Hayward regular black holes embedded in a quintessence dark energy (DE) field.
